constraints: Passing an explicit window reference number has no effect for windows opened via Open window/Open form window: CLOSE WINDOW always closes the last window created by one of those two commands regardless of the number passed.
An explicit window reference number is only meaningful to target an external window (opened outside of Open window/Open form window).
Has no effect if no custom window is open, if called while a form is active in the window, or targeting a system window.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Closes the active custom window previously opened by Open window or Open form window in the current process (or a specified external window).
